title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Travellers Needing Special Handling
content:
The fare brand held on the booking governs what the desk charges for travellers needing special handling on a ticket sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands. An infant travelling on the lap is charged a percentage of the adult base fare. A traveller aged 2 to 11 is a child for this purpose, and the adult base fare is reduced by the percentage shown. An unaccompanied minor carries a fee for each direction of travel. Special assistance is registered before departure by the lead time shown.

| Fare brand | Infant on the lap, of the adult base fare | Child discount off the adult base fare | Unaccompanied minor fee, each direction | Special assistance registered before departure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 10 percent | 0 percent | 175.00 dollars | 72 hours |
| Economy Saver | 10 percent | 0 percent | 175.00 dollars | 72 hours |
| Economy Classic | 10 percent | 5 percent | 150.00 dollars | 48 hours |
| Economy Flex | 10 percent | 10 percent | 150.00 dollars | 48 hours |
| Premium Economy Select | 10 percent | 10 percent | 150.00 dollars | 48 hours |
| Business Saver | 10 percent | 15 percent | 125.00 dollars | 24 hours |
| Business Flex | 10 percent | 20 percent | 125.00 dollars | 24 hours |

Bases of judgement:

The infant charge stands at 10 percent of the adult base fare on all seven fare brands, and the brand held does not move it. Where the child discount stands at 0 percent, as it does in Basic Economy Lite and in Economy Saver, the child is charged the adult base fare in full.

On a hypothetical adult base fare of 800.00 dollars in Business Flex, the infant on the lap is charged 10 percent of that fare, that is 80.00 dollars, and the child is charged that fare less a discount of 20 percent, that is 640.00 dollars. On the same hypothetical fare in Economy Classic, the child discount of 5 percent leaves 760.00 dollars.

The unaccompanied minor fee is charged once for each direction travelled, so a hypothetical return journey in Economy Classic carries 150.00 dollars outbound and 150.00 dollars on the return.

The lead time is met by a registration made no later than the hour shown before departure. A hypothetical Business Saver segment for which special assistance is registered 30 hours before departure meets the lead time of 24 hours; the same segment registered 12 hours before departure does not.
